newsitem.title: USA: A.P. Green Q4 net down on higher costs.
newsitem.headline: A.P. Green Q4 net down on higher costs.

text.p: A.P. Green Industries Inc said on Thursday relatively high start-up costs for several ventures pulled down earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company reported net income of $435,000, or $0.05 a share, down from $2.3 million, or $0.29 a share, one year ago. Revenues climbed to $62.7 million compared to $60.9 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
A.P. Green said it expects the ventures in Mexico, Indonesia and the United States to eventually contribute significantly to its earnings.
The company mines and processes specialty minerals.
Its shares closed up 1/2 Thursday at 8-3/4.
